summary: Iteration 11 verification of the Coming Soon / Active storefront rules (backend + frontend). New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_coming_soon_v3.py (14 tests, 13 pass serially, 1 intentional failure documenting a real defect). Verified: GET /api/products returns active-only publicly and DOES include coming_soon products; include_inactive=true returns the superset; PUT /api/products/{id} persists active/coming_soon/is_featured; POST /api/orders/checkout returns 400 '<name> is not available yet' for coming_soon items (alone and mixed with a valid item) and 400 'unavailable' for inactive items; POST /api/waitlist persists an entry for a coming-soon product and shows in /api/admin/waitlist without _id. Playwright: /products shows all 3 coming-soon products (1M Stardust, 2 Shundo) under 'All', under their own category tabs, each with coming-soon-overlay-{id} + coming-soon-notice-{id} + join-waitlist-{id} and NO add-to-cart-{id}; the inactive Shundo product is hidden from the storefront but still listed in Admin > Products with '· INACTIVE · SOON'; Join Waitlist (guest prompt) succeeded with a success toast. Home: after starring a coming-soon Stardust and a coming-soon Shundo product, both render inside home-section-stardust / home-section-shundo_service with the overlay and no Add-to-cart; the marketing 'Shundo Hunting Services' section contains 0 product cards + 1 image (no hardcoded product rendering remains); the inactive Shundo never appears. Admin: helper text about Active vs Coming soon present, product-active-checkbox/product-coming-soon-checkbox prefill and save correctly, storefront reflects the change immediately, revert via UI works. Regression: Event Pass lock/unlock via coin bundle, cart drawer, checkout page + totals all fine; auth playbook suite re-run (9/11, same 2 pre-existing lockout failures); backend_test.py 84/89 (see minor items).

critical.issue: is_featured is silently reset to False on every update. ProductIn.is_featured defaults to False and the admin form (Admin.jsx editProduct/saveProduct) does not send it, so editing a product un-stars it. Real user impact: an admin who ticks 'Coming soon' in the edit form also loses the star, so the product vanishes from the Home page — the exact symptom in the bug report. Fix: make is_featured (and active/coming_soon) Optional in a dedicated update model and $set only provided fields, and/or include is_featured in the admin form state. Reproduced by tests/test_coming_soon_v3.py::TestFeaturedPreservedOnUpdate and by the Admin UI run (10M Stardust Farming lost its star after a form save; I restored it).

minor.issue: No auth required — any anonymous caller can list products the admin has deliberately pulled down (verified with plain curl, returned the inactive Shundo product). Gate include_inactive behind get_admin_user.

Pre-existing from iteration 10 and still unfixed: brute-force lockout keyed on request.client.host (ingress pod IP) so lockout fires on attempt 8 instead of 6 and a successful login only clears one proxy's counter (tests/test_auth_playbook_v2.py TestBruteForceLockout, 2 failures).

Stale assertion 'no stardust product is coming_soon' now contradicts the feature; it fails because '1M Stardust Farming' is still coming_soon=true in the DB (the main agent's note said this toggle was reverted — it was not). Decide: revert that product or delete the obsolete assertion.

test_public_get_guest_order / test_public_get_messages fail with AttributeError: module 'pytest' has no attribute 'paid_order_id' — cross-class state shared via the pytest module under -n 2 loadscope (worker isolation). Test-infra flakiness, not a product bug.

integration_issues.issue: Saving the edit form drops the featured star (see the PUT /api/products/{id} critical issue) — the product silently disappears from the Home page.

issues: When a shundo_service product is starred, the page renders two consecutive identical H2 headings 'Shundo Hunting Services' (the featured-category grid immediately followed by the marketing/phase-two section) — visually redundant; consider renaming one (e.g. grid heading 'Shundo Hunting' vs marketing block) or moving the marketing block above the featured grid.

Coming-soon cards still show the price in the buy-now cyan and would still render the -x% savings badge if an MSRP is set, which reads as a live offer on a non-purchasable item. Minor: mute the price / suppress product-savings-{id} when coming_soon.

action_items: Stop PUT /api/products/{id} from wiping is_featured (Optional fields + $set of provided keys, and carry is_featured in the Admin edit form state).
Decide on '1M Stardust Farming' still being coming_soon=true in the DB and update/remove the stale TestStardustVisibility assertion in backend_test.py.
Optional polish: de-duplicate the two 'Shundo Hunting Services' headings on Home; mute price/savings badge on coming-soon cards.
Still open from iteration 10: brute-force lockout identifier (X-Forwarded-For or email-only key).
critical_code_review_comments: models.py ProductIn is reused for both create and update; every boolean with a default (active, coming_soon, is_featured) is therefore destructive on PUT. Introduce ProductUpdate with Optional fields and payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).
Home.jsx: SECTIONS-driven rendering plus a copy-only Shundo marketing block is clean and the hardcoded featuredShundo path is gone — verified 0 product cards inside the marketing section.
ProductCard.jsx correctly makes comingSoon win over the event_pass lock (locked = !comingSoon && ...) so a coming-soon Event Pass shows Join Waitlist rather than Locked.

resolve_items() checks active in the Mongo query and coming_soon right after, so the purchase guard cannot be bypassed by a crafted cart payload — verified for single, mixed and freshly-flagged items.
test_coming_soon_v3.py mutates shared seeded products; run it with -n 0 (serially) or the two mutating classes race across xdist workers (observed one false failure under -n 2).

success_rate.backend: 96% (13/14 new suite serially, 84/89 regression, 9/11 auth playbook; the single new-suite failure is the documented is_featured wipe)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the coming-soon/active requirements (products page, home page, admin form, waitlist, event-pass regression)

rca_of_the_issue: The reported 'Coming Soon products vanish' symptom is fully fixed at the data/render layer (list_products only filters on active; ProductCard renders overlay + Join Waitlist; Home renders shundo_service through the generic SECTIONS grid). However a second, still-live cause remains: PUT /api/products/{id} validates against ProductIn where is_featured defaults to False and the Admin edit form never sends it, so an admin who ticks 'Coming soon' in the form saves is_featured=false and the product drops off the Home page even though it is still on /products. Confirmed by API test and reproduced through the Admin UI.
